meta.title: Buka Robots
meta.description: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar: each robot is a directory the plugin creates under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots and mounts as a DSH workspace, with project-level skills installed through npx skills, an editable AGENTS.md, a preset avatar and a one-sentence responsibility statement. The plugin also ships the robot-builder mode and, on a fresh install, seeds two editable preset robots; other plugins reach robots through the ctx.bukaRobots service.
